title: Kids Cheering (Yay!)
blurb: Unfiltered childhood celebration, and about as sincere as recorded audio gets. Children cheer without any of the calculation adults bring to it. No checking whether the enthusiasm is proportionate, no waiting to see how the room reacts — just total commitment from the first syllable. It suits wins that deserve pure joy: cake arriving, school closing for snow, the ice cream van proving it exists. Applied ironically to a minor adult accomplishment, it turns quietly devastating. Either way, the children are thrilled for you.
origin: Classic children's cheer of pure celebration.
